EvidenceBody: In one public interview an unnamed monk asks Changqing Da'an what it is like when great function manifests without preserving rules. Changqing answers, “if you can use it, then use it” (汝用得但用); the recorded questioner bares his shoulder and is struck. Another unnamed monk asks Shanhui separately, “what is great capacity?” and “what is great function?” and receives a blow across the back for each. The corpus coordinates “great capacity and great function” (大機大用, 325 occurrences) and “the whole capacity and great function” (全機大用, 128 occurrences). Yuanwu Keqin uses the first pairing in instruction to Deshan Jing and the second while describing meeting life with life and death with death. Guishan Lingyou supplies an explicit contrast: “you people have obtained only the great body, not great function” (汝等諸人只得大體不得大用). Yangshan Huiji identifies Baizhang Huaihai with great capacity and Huangbo Xiyun with great function. Xuansha Shibei asks Xuefeng Yicun what it is like when great function manifests, and Xuefeng rolls three balls together. These formulas, questions, bodily replies, pairings, and contrasts show a function publicly displayed and appraised in encounters; they do not establish a separate metaphysical object behind the term.
